blackout:2026-11-28.expect: No official guidance from Saturday to 10 Dec, the day after the 9 Dec meeting. Hike odds move on data and press reports only, and PCE is the one US print on this week's calendar.
blackout:2026-11-28.name: Fed communications blackout begins (to 10 Dec)

eia:2026-11-25.expect: No consensus in the feed yet; last week built 3.4 mb. WTI is 83.41, down 16.1% in a month and 6% under its 200-day, against a fresh divergence alert (+1.7, smart money buying); producers sit at Watch (exit) with no condition on.
eia:2026-11-25.name: EIA crude inventories
eia:2026-11-25.stronger: A third build: crude extends its slide under the 200-day, the producers' Macro condition stays off, and energy's Aligned up read (conditions +1.0, price +1.4) is tested.
eia:2026-11-25.weaker: A draw: crude and producers up, in the direction of the smart money alert; a close back above the 200-day would return the producers' Macro condition.

pce:2026-11-25.expect: Core 0.3% against 0.3%, after October's core CPI beat by 0.1. It works through the futures path, still pricing most of a December hike but 2.3 hikes over the year against 3.3 a week ago, and through real yields at 2.88%.
pce:2026-11-25.name: PCE inflation, income and spending
pce:2026-11-25.stronger: Core 0.4% or more: the December hike firms and real yields rise; gold, down 9.5% on the week with trend followers short, and small caps (Neutral) lose, and the dollar extends.
pce:2026-11-25.weaker: Core 0.2%: the path loses more of the December hike and real yields ease; gold and the miners (both Price ahead, down) get their driver back, homebuilders (Early) get rate relief, the dollar softens.

week.text: A stress week with a short calendar: the S&P fell 8.6% last week, VIX sits above VIX3M, credit stress reads stress with high yield at 352 bp, and dealer gamma is at the bottom of its range, so moves are amplified rather than damped. Futures took a full hike out of the year but still price most of December. Wednesday's PCE is the one US print; the US is closed Thursday, and options prices are missing while Cboe's chain feed refuses requests.
